#summary Instructions for cross-compiling PARI/GP (2.5.0-STABLE) for Android.
#labels Featured,Phase-Deploy

= Prerequisites =

  * PARI/GP source code.
  * Latest version of the Android SDK and NDK.
  * A working Android development environment.
  * A rooted Android device (or the Android Emulator).

----

= Cross-Compiling PARI/GP =

First, download the `pari.cfg` file.

{{{
wget http://paridroid.googlecode.com/svn/pari.cfg
}}}

Modify `TOP` to point to the right place (and other parameters if you need to), move this file to the top-level directory of your working copy of Pari's source code, then build as usual.

{{{
./Configure -l pari.cfg
cd Oandroid-arm
make -j4 all
}}}

----

= Pushing files to the device =

== Make the directories to hold the files ==

{{{
adb shell
su
cd /data/local
mkdir bin
mkdir lib
}}}

Now `C-c` to get out of `adb shell`.

{{{
adb push gp-dyn /data/local/bin
adb push gp-sta /data/local/bin
adb push libpari.* /data/local/lib
}}}

Once the files are pushed to the phone:

{{{
adb shell
cd /data/local/bin
chmod 0777 gp-sta
chmod 0777 go-dyn
./gp-sta #or gp-dyn
}}}
